what: Test vectors of triattn_pkg generation 11. Each case names the compute capabilities it is a vector for (`cc`); the 17 cc-9.0 cases are generation 10's (inputs, expected bytes, reference rows and error records identical), made with generation 10's package face and its shipped sm_90a binaries on H100 80GB HBM3; the a80_* cases are the cc-8.0 vectors of the sm_80 member, made on A100-SXM4-80GB with this generation's face and its shipped sm_80 binary. `made` holds the generating interpreter / device facts per cc.
